title: TCS is excluded as a 600,000-staff enterprise anti-persona despite holding Flowable and Camunda Gold listings
content:
Tata Consultancy Services appears in the Flowable Partner Finder with 600,000+ staff, a dual Camunda Gold listing, and an enterprise anti-persona label that puts it in the do-not-pitch tier.

The interesting part is the ordering. The highest partner tier observed anywhere in this sweep belongs to the firm the brief is least able to reach. Looking across the sweep, the pattern holds: Accenture at 513,000 staff, EPAM with Camunda Silver, TCS with Camunda Gold — tier height tracks the scale that puts a firm outside a practice-level motion, rather than tracking suitability.

The operational conclusion is to screen a partner directory by size before reading its tiers. Tier badges are the most visible field on a partner card and the least predictive one for this brief, and taking them at face value would direct attention to exactly the entries that cannot be acted on.
